title: Aromatic Smoky Chinese Radish Xiaolongbao
description: Smoky and snappy xiaolongbao featuring radish and bhuna, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated radish, bhuna sauce, smoked salmon, green onion, and ginger, and mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a tablespoon of the radish mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the xiaolongbao.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large steamer basket, arrange the xiaolongbao in a single layer, leaving some space between each one.
Steam the xiaolongbao over boiling water for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil and soy sauce.
Serve the xiaolongbao with the sesame oil and soy sauce mixture for dipping.
